name: kui-react
description: Machine-readable catalog of every component, theme, design token, and convention in the kui-react library. Consume this from an AI assistant to know what exists, where it lives, and how to use it.

layers.ui: modules/ui/ — Primitive, locally-stateful components (atoms + molecules). No business logic. Every file starts with 'use client' and imports cn from @/libs/utils/cn.
layers.app: modules/app/ — Application-level patterns (organisms, page shells, forms, providers). May own local state and orchestrate ui-layer atoms.
layers.domain: modules/domains/<vertical>/ — Industry-vertical components that compose ui/ + app/. Each vertical exports a barrel index.ts and a types.ts with Zod schemas.
layers.theme: app/theme/<vertical>/ — Full multi-page demos wiring domain components into a realistic product experience. layout.tsx is client, page.tsx is server unless it owns state.
layers.library: External npm packages featured in the showcase (e.g. kui-viewer). filePath points to the showcase example, not first-party source; the `external` field carries homepage/npm/github links.

conventions.icons: All icons MUST come from Font Awesome. Named imports only — never the whole set. Apply Tailwind classes via className (e.g. text-primary, w-4 h-4); never use the size prop with raw strings. aria-hidden="true" on decorative icons.
conventions.styling: Tailwind CSS 4 with CSS-variable design tokens. Use cn() from @/libs/utils/cn for class composition — never raw template literals. Reference token names (bg-primary, text-text-secondary) — never hex.
conventions.types: Define props inline with a local type. Domain layers use Zod schemas in types.ts. Components export named functions — never default exports (excluding next/dynamic wrappers).
conventions.accessibility: Use semantic HTML. Apply aria-busy / aria-invalid / aria-describedby / aria-pressed / aria-expanded as relevant. ALWAYS include focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-border-focus on interactive elements. Use disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed for disabled state.
conventions.fileNaming: UI/Domain components: PascalCase .tsx. Showcase builders: kebab-case .showcase.tsx. Utilities: camelCase .ts. Domain directories: lowercase.
conventions.pathAlias: @/ resolves to the project root. Import as: @/modules/ui/<Component>, @/modules/app/<Component>, @/modules/domains/<vertical>, @/libs/utils/cn.

components.name: Button
components.description: Core interactive element. Supports 5 visual styles (variants) and 5 sizes. disabled, loading and selected states are built-in.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status, category or label indicator. 6 semantic variants, 3 sizes, dot and dismissible support.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: User profile photo or initials indicator. 5 sizes with optional status dot. When no image is provided, initials render on a bg-primary-subtle / text-primary tile.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: CSS border-based loading indicator. Does not require FontAwesome. 5 sizes, border-border / border-t-primary colour system.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Animated placeholder shown before content loads. Uses animate-pulse bg-surface-sunken. aria-busy="true" ensures accessibility.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.description: Segmented button group for mutually-exclusive options. Supports 4 variants, 4 sizes and disabled items.

components.name: SkipLink + LiveRegion
components.description: SkipLink is visually hidden until focused, enabling keyboard users to bypass navigation. LiveRegion announces dynamic content to screen readers.

components.name: BrandLogo
components.description: Brand mark: a logo image (light / dark variants) when given, otherwise a single letter or short token on a primary-coloured tile. 5 sizes (sm → 2xl).

components.name: StarRating
components.description: Five-star rating indicator. Read-only by default with decimal/half-star rendering; pass `readonly={false}` + `onChange` for interactive whole-star selection.
components.whenToUse: Surface a 0–5 star score (e.g. product / hotel / restaurant ratings) or let users submit a new rating.
components.whenNotToUse: For non-star scales (e.g. NPS, percentages) use ContentScoreBar or a custom indicator instead.

components.name: Label
components.description: Standalone form label with an optional required indicator and disabled state, for pairing with custom controls that do not manage their own label.

components.name: Separator
components.description: Visual divider between sections of content. Supports horizontal and vertical orientation, and an optional centered label for horizontal dividers.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: Scrollable container with a themed, thin scrollbar (Firefox scrollbar-color + WebKit pseudo-elements) instead of the bulky native default. Supports vertical, horizontal, or both-axis scrolling.

components.name: Progress
components.description: Determinate progress indicator as a bar or a circle, with variant colors and an optional percentage label.

components.name: Statistic
components.description: Bare numeric/text figure with a label, optional prefix/suffix, trend indicator, and loading skeleton — no card chrome (compose with Card for a bordered KPI tile).

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input field with label, hint, error, prefix icon, password toggle, and 3 size variants.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Label + textarea + hint + error anatomy. Vertical resizing is enabled via resize-y and the parts are linked through aria-describedby.

components.name: SearchBar
components.description: role="searchbox" with search icon and clear button. Works in controlled and uncontrolled modes.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Label + checkbox + optional hint / error message. aria-describedby is wired up and border-error is applied on the error state.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: fieldset + legend based radio group. WCAG-compliant keyboard navigation with an optional card-style variant.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: role="switch" toggle/switch with three sizes, description slot, and disabled support. Fully accessible via CSS transform without a native input.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.description: Chip-style multi-select group. Selected chips use bg-primary-subtle / border-primary tokens. Keyboard accessible.

components.name: Select
components.description: Label + select + hint + error anatomy. appearance-none overrides the native dropdown style and renders a chevron icon.

components.name: TagInput
components.description: Free-text input that creates chips. Add tags with Enter or comma, double-click to edit, Backspace to delete. Duplicates are ignored.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.description: Chip-based multi-select popover with searchable filter, keyboard navigation, and disabled-option support.

components.name: ComboBox
components.description: Searchable autocomplete single-select with keyboard navigation, described options, and a clearable button.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Popover-based date picker with a locale-aware calendar grid (TR / EN), quick month / year jump from the header, min / max / disabledDates support, and full keyboard navigation (Arrow / PageUp/Down / Shift+Page / Home / End / Enter / Esc). Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/ui/DatePicker/DatePicker.ejs.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: Two-month popover for picking a start → end date range. Shares the same Calendar core as DatePicker; locale-aware, fully keyboard navigable, with min/max/disabledDates. Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/ui/DatePicker/DateRangePicker.ejs.

components.name: FileInput
components.description: Drag-and-drop file upload with validation, file list, and individual remove actions. M1 adds paste-from-clipboard, `accept` MIME-pattern + extension validation, and `maxFiles` enforcement with i18n messages. Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/ui/FileInput/FileInput.ejs.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.description: Color selection control with a 32-swatch preset palette plus optional hex input and native browser color picker for unlimited colors. M1 adds a HEX / RGBA / HSLA / HWB / OKLCH format-switcher with per-format input + copy. Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/ui/ColorPicker/ColorPicker.ejs. Used by RichTextEditor for text + highlight colors.

components.name: DiffViewer
components.description: Line-based text diff viewer with unified (GitHub-style) and split (yan yana) modes. M1 ships a zero-dep LCS algorithm, hunk headers in `@@ -old,n +new,n @@` form, old/new line-number gutters, configurable context window, and optional collapsible unchanged regions. Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/ui/DiffViewer/DiffViewer.ejs.

keyboardInteractions.action: Move focus into the diff region
Expand a collapsed unchanged run (when collapsible=true)

a11y.notes: TODO M5: J/K next/prev change, N/P next/prev file, full roving tabindex + screen-reader line announcements.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Vertically stacked, collapsible content panels. Single-open by default, or `allowMultiple` for independent panels. Fully keyboard accessible via native `<button>` disclosure headers.

components.name: RangeSlider
components.description: Numeric range input built on native `<input type="range">`. Single-handle by default, or `range` for a dual-handle min/max selector. Distinct from the `Slider` carousel component.

components.name: Popconfirm
components.description: Inline "are you sure?" confirmation popover for destructive or consequential actions — lighter-weight than a full Modal. Built on the same dismiss/focus-trap primitives as Popover.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: The one confirmation of the design system: a question, its consequence and two buttons, plus optional gates in any combination: an input (a reason, a name, a date), a responsibility text to tick, and a phrase to type. Controlled, or imperative through confirmDialog() with one ConfirmHost. Never use window.confirm / window.prompt.

keyboardInteractions.action: Move between the fields, Cancel and the confirm button
Confirm from a single-line field once every gate is met

components.name: TimePicker
components.description: Native `<input type="time">`-based time field with label/hint/error slots, matching the Input/DatePicker pattern. M1 baseline — hour/minute only, no timezone or 12h/24h toggle yet (tracked for the DateTimePicker milestone).
components.whenNotToUse: For combined date + time selection, wait for the upcoming DateTimePicker (composes DatePicker + TimePicker) rather than pairing these two manually.

components.name: ControlTile
components.description: Async controls: a frame (`ControlTile`) plus `ControlButton`, `ControlSwitch`, `ControlSlider` and `ControlSetpoint`. Each takes the bound `value` and an `onCommit` that returns a Promise, and shows idle -> pending -> confirmed / mismatch / failed with the previous value restored on failure. The slider writes once on release. State machine: `useAsyncControl` (libs/hooks). No transport knowledge; all text is overridable through `messages`.

a11y.notes: The status line is an aria-live region; a failure is role="alert". Pending sets aria-busy and disables the input. A bad set-point is a field error (aria-invalid + described-by) and sends nothing.

components.name: TimeWindowPicker
components.description: Relative presets ("1h", "7d"), an optional custom "last N minutes / hours / days", calendar periods ("today", "previous month", optionally "so far"), an absolute UTC range, and the interval / aggregation / time zone that go with a window. Controlled: the value is a structural `TimeWindowValue`, nothing here knows about dashboards. Every label, period names included, is overridable through `messages`.

a11y.notes: Presets, Last, Calendar and Custom form one radiogroup; the inputs, the period select, the so-far checkbox (disabled for a past period) and the selects carry accessible names from `messages`.

components.name: TimeWindowSelect
components.description: A time window behind one button, the dashboard way: the button names the window and opens a panel with Realtime (last N sliding, or the current calendar period, optionally so far) and History (last N anchored when applied, a fixed range typed in the window's zone, or a past period). Aggregation, grouping interval with a bucket estimate, and time zone apply to both. Edits are a draft until Update. Same `TimeWindowValue` as TimeWindowPicker.

a11y.notes: The trigger has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; Realtime / History are tabs (arrow keys); every input has an accessible name from `messages`; the bucket estimate is a status; Escape and Cancel discard the draft.

components.name: useAsyncControl (hook)
components.description: State machine behind ControlTile: idle -> pending -> confirmed / mismatch / failed. `commit` returns a Promise (a rejection rolls the display back to the bound `value`); an optional `reported` value keeps the write pending until the other side agrees, else it ends as mismatch after `timeoutMs`; `confirm` parks the value until `accept()` / `dismiss()`. No transport knowledge. Lives in libs/hooks/useAsyncControl.ts.

components.name: Chart
components.description: Token-aware primitive chart library at @/modules/ui/Chart. M1 ships seven SVG-based charts (Line, Bar, Area, Pie, Donut, Scatter, SparkLine) that consume a unified `Series` data shape. Colors auto-resolve from --primary / --secondary / --success / --warning / --error / --info, so dark mode and theme swaps work without any extra work. Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/ui/Chart/Chart.ejs. GaugeChart, HeatmapChart and the time axis (`xAxis="time"` with drag-to-zoom on Line/Area) have their own pages (gauge-chart, heatmap-chart, time-series-chart); Bar/Area take `stacked`. The remaining M3 stubs (BubbleChart, TreemapChart, RadarChart, FunnelChart, SankeyChart, CandlestickChart) are exported but render null until implemented; see PLANS/38-Charts.md.

a11y.notes: Each chart SVG uses role="img" + aria-label. M5 will add a visually hidden data table for screen-reader parity and keyboard navigation between data points.

components.name: GaugeChart
components.description: Half-donut gauge (role="meter") with threshold bands, optional needle, three sizes and a stale state for readings that stopped updating. Part of the Chart library (`@/modules/ui/Chart`); the colour comes from semantic tokens through `bands[].tone`.

a11y.notes: role="meter" with aria-valuemin / aria-valuemax / aria-valuenow and an aria-label from `label`.

components.name: HeatmapChart
components.description: Matrix of cells coloured on one token scale. A missing value (`null`) renders as an empty cell, never as 0, so gaps in the data stay visible. Hover shows the value; the scale can be fixed with `min` / `max`.

a11y.notes: role="img" with an aria-label; the hover tooltip repeats the cell value as text.

components.name: TimeSeriesChart
components.description: The continuous time axis behind `LineChart` / `AreaChart` with `xAxis="time"`: timestamps (ISO strings or epoch ms) in `x`, uneven sampling, series with different instants on one axis, and drag-to-zoom (double-click or "Reset zoom" to leave). Zoom is local to the chart and never reaches the caller.

a11y.notes: role="img" with an aria-label; the tooltip and crosshair follow the nearest sample.

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container with raised / flat / outline variants and default / compact density (compact: 16 px sides, for narrow side panels and embedded views). Supports title, subtitle, headerRight, footer slots and loading skeleton state.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: Page title + subtitle + optional badge + action buttons. Supports 5 button variants (primary/secondary/outline/danger/ghost); rendered as a link with href or as a button.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Accessible carousel. Includes role="region" + aria-roledescription="carousel" and per-slide aria labels. Supports autoplay, arrow keys, and dot navigation.

components.name: StatCard
components.description: Compact metric display card with value, label, and optional accent color.

components.name: AlertBanner
components.description: Page-level info, success, warning or error message. Announced via role="alert" for screen readers with optional dismissible and action support.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Notification system with success/warning/error/info/loading variants. Hover-to-freeze, progress bar, title, actions, and promise support.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: Empty-state message shown when there is no data. Supports icon, title, description, and action slots.

components.name: ContributionBoundary
components.description: Error boundary for one contribution (a slot item, tab, widget or block): when it throws, only it is replaced by `fallback` (a node or `({ error, reset }) => node`, nothing by default) and its host keeps working. `onError(error, info)` reports; `resetKeys` resets when any value changes.

components.name: UnavailableContribution
components.description: Placeholder for a contribution that cannot be shown, for admins and editors (end users see nothing). Nine reasons (disabled, unentitled, blocked, retired, banned, quarantined, failed, missing, no-access), each with a default icon, tone and short text; four sizes (inline, card, tab, node); optional title, detail and action. Texts are overridable for i18n.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page navigation control. Collapses large page counts with ellipsis; accessible via aria-label and aria-current="page".

components.name: TabGroup
components.description: Accessible tab navigation following the role="tablist" / role="tab" / role="tabpanel" ARIA pattern. Arrow-key navigation; tabIndex=-1 on inactive tabs. Optional per-tab isolation (error boundary + Suspense), `order` and per-tab `lazy` for tabs other modules contribute.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Hierarchical navigation trail wrapped in a nav landmark (ariaLabel, default "Breadcrumb"). Last item marked with aria-current="page" and aria-hidden separators. renderLink renders linked items through a router Link for client-side navigation. Items take an icon, a chip (pill) style and a status tone dot; `leading` puts a node (a page-menu button) first, never collapsed by maxItems.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Multi-step progress indicator with complete, active, warning, error, and pending states. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

components.name: TreeView
components.description: Collapsible tree with keyboard navigation, selection, and aria-tree roles.

components.name: TabButton
components.description: Pill-style tab button with active/inactive coloring and an optional count badge.

components.name: ViewToggle
components.description: Horizontal / vertical view toggle control; two-state icon selector. Emits a viewtoggle:change CustomEvent.

components.name: Callout
components.description: Docs-style admonition (note, tip, info, warning, danger) for authored content. A labelled <aside>, never a live region — use AlertBanner for system feedback.

components.name: TableOfContents
components.description: "On this page" heading navigation with built-in scroll-spy (IntersectionObserver) or a controlled activeId. Filters by heading depth.

components.name: DocPager
components.description: Previous / next page cards for the foot of a document. Each side names its neighbour; renderLink plugs in a router Link.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Focus-trapped dialog. Closes on Escape and backdrop click. Requires role="dialog" + aria-modal + aria-labelledby; supports sm/md/lg/xl/full sizes (full = viewport width less the gutter; fullscreen fills the viewport). An Escape an inner control already handled (an open ComboBox / Select list) closes that control, not the dialog. Uses the shared Overlays focus-trap, scroll-lock and presence hooks; nested modals are layer-aware so Escape only dismisses the topmost panel.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Side panel sliding in from the screen edge. Left / right placement with focus management and Escape close. Body scroll is locked while open via the shared Overlays useScrollLock hook (iOS rubber-band safe). closeOnRouteChange closes it when the Next.js pathname changes while open, as the AppShell mobile sidebar does.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Short hint shown on hover and focus. Accessible via role="tooltip" + aria-describedby. Supports 4 placements, 3 themes, optional arrow, and configurable delay.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Accessible dropdown using role="menu" + role="menuitem". Closes on Escape and outside click. Supports left/right alignment, icons, separators, danger and disabled items, and arrow-key navigation. Items take an optional id, href, group, order, hidden and disabledReason so other modules can contribute entries; `portal` escapes clipping parents. Page-menu extras: heading entries (or `groupLabels` per group), `selected` and `trailing` items, a `search` box once the list is long, a `footer`, `menuClassName`, and controlled `open` / `onOpenChange`.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Anchor-based contextual panel. Closes on outside click (capture-phase pointerdown) and Escape, layered with sibling overlays. Supports top/bottom/left/right placement. Built-in focus trap (focusTrap prop) keeps Tab cycling inside the panel. `shrinkTrigger` caps the trigger wrapper at its container's width, so a `max-w-full` / `truncate` trigger shrinks instead of overflowing.

components.name: Table
components.description: Responsive table. scope="col" headers, hover row highlight, empty-state message, and custom cell render support.

components.name: DataTable
components.description: Unified table with `mode="static" | "paginated" | "server" | "manual"` (manual: the host owns the rows and fetches from `onQueryChange`; server: `reloadKey`, debounced search, aborted stale requests, rows kept under a spinner while the next page loads, Retry). Live rows (`rowState` new / leaving, keyboard rows, `isRowSelectable`), columns with `hideBelow`, `sortKey`, `footer` and `width`, `multiSort`, active-filter chips with Clear all, date-range presets, `numberrange` fields and per-field `defaultValue`, a card shell (`variant="card"`, `title`, `headerActions`, `toolbarStart` / `toolbarEnd`, `density`, `bulkActions`), a card layout (`layout="cards"` + `renderCard`, with a Sort by select) and every string in `messages`. Multi-column sort (Shift+click), global search, per-column filter (text + select), pagination, unified loading/empty/error state, a filter panel (`filterFields`: select, multiselect, checkboxes, radio, checkbox, text, number, date, daterange, range, custom — sent to the server as `filterValues`), row selection keyed by row id (`selectable`, `rowId`, `selectedRowIds`, `onSelectionChange`), expandable detail rows (`renderExpanded`), `stickyHeader`, and `rowActions` (a per-row actions menu with id, href, hidden, disabledReason, destructive, group and order). Phase 11.16: `groupBy` + `renderGroupHeader` (a header row, or a heading before each group of cards), `isRowSelectionLocked` (ticked, disabled, not counted), `searchText` and per-column `searchValue` / `searchable: false`, `render(row, { index, id })`, empty cells sorted last, priority numbers only for a user-built multi-sort, and `required` / `placement: 'toolbar'` select and radio filter fields. An opt-in column chooser (`columnChooser`, with `Column.hideable` / `defaultHidden`) saves the viewer's choice on the device under `tableId`.

components.name: AdvancedDataTable
components.description: Deprecated: use DataTable with `selectable`, `renderExpanded` and `stickyHeader`. Thin wrapper kept until removal; row selection (with indeterminate header), expandable rows, and optional sticky header.

components.name: ContentScoreBar
components.description: Rule-based content quality score with Good ≥70 / Fair ≥40 / Poor <40 tier system. Each rule shown as a chip with passed/total count. role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow.

components.name: BulkActionTable
components.description: Table with **id-keyed** row selection and a bulk-action bar. `DataTable`’s own `selectable` prop keys selection by array index and only works in the deprecated legacy view, so selections there follow the wrong rows once anything sorts or paginates.

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Chronological activity feed with sticky day headings, `order` (newest or oldest first), step `status` (done, current, upcoming: a hollow marker) and undated entries (no or invalid `at`: drawn last without a time, never a RangeError). Grouping uses the viewer’s local day via `Intl`, not the raw ISO date — an event at 23:50 UTC otherwise lands under the wrong heading for anyone east or west of the server. A day heading lines up with the events’ text, keeps a gap above the first marker and is drawn in the timeline’s `surface` (`raised` inside a card), so it never reads as a band of another colour; the last event leaves no space under it.

components.name: KeyedTable
components.description: A rows-in, events-out table for data that changes under the viewer: stable row keys, keyboard row focus (Arrow keys, Home/End, Enter), a per-row state (new = highlighted, leaving = fading), optional selection checkboxes, loading / error (retry) / empty states, and columns that hide below a breakpoint.

components.name: TypedConfirmDialog
components.description: A confirmation that needs the user to type an exact phrase (a serial, a command word) before confirming: stronger than Popconfirm for actions that cannot be undone.

components.name: VideoPlayer
components.description: Custom HTML5 video player. Quality, subtitle, audio track, and playback rate selection; custom WebVTT subtitle overlay; auto-hiding controls; programmatic API. Keyboard shortcuts: Space/K=play, ←→=±10s, ↑↓=volume, M=mute, F=fullscreen.

components.name: ImageGallery
components.description: Responsive image grid with a full-screen lightbox, right-click context menu (open, copy URL, move to first/last, remove), and drag-to-reorder. Supports 2–4 columns, square / video / portrait / auto aspect ratios, optional captions, zoom toggle, thumbnail strip, and full keyboard navigation (← → Escape).

components.name: DescriptionList
components.description: Label/value pairs of one record for detail pages: inline (label left, value right) or stacked, 1–3 columns that collapse on a phone, a dash for empty values, monospace values and a copy button for ids and keys, wide items that span the grid.

components.name: BarList
components.description: A ranked breakdown for report pages: label, a bar to scale and the value, sorted by value (or label, or as given), optional share of the total, a row limit, links per row and an empty message.

components.name: OrgChart
components.description: A top-down tree of the host's own cards joined by connector lines: nested or flat data (buildOrgTree), collapsible subtrees, highlight that opens the path to every match (search), zoom, and a keyboard tree (Up parent, Down first child, Left/Right siblings, Enter clicks, * opens all children).

components.name: ChatThread
components.description: A controlled chat thread: messages oldest first (own / other / system), sticks to the bottom while the reader is there and offers a "New messages" button once they scroll up, "Load older" that keeps the reading position, a streamed last message, who is typing, day separators, status badges, attachments, keyboard-reachable per-message actions, a composer slot and every string from `messages`. role="log", each message an article named by author and time.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: Full-screen layout wrapper with logo, sidebar and topbar slots. Sidebar renders as an aside on desktop and opens via a drawer on mobile.

components.name: AppSidebar
components.description: Collapsible side navigation. Accepts navGroups or navItems with a built-in collapse toggle. The searchable prop adds an inline filter; a header slot (above the nav groups) and a footer slot can host a workspace switcher, a user block or any content. Item badges take a count or any node. Items nest through children, indented behind a disclosure toggle; the branch holding the active item opens, also when activeId changes after client-side navigation, and search keeps the branch down to a match. renderLink swaps the plain anchors for a router Link. headerClassName / footerClassName style the slot wrappers, e.g. to hide the whole strip at a breakpoint. The active item, link or button, is marked aria-current="page"; collapsed, the nav shows top-level items only and reserves no scrollbar gutter, so the icons stay centered.

components.name: AppTopBar
components.description: Top bar wrapper passed into AppShell's header slot. The logo slot anchors the left side while children (GlobalSearch, UserMenu, Button, etc.) are arranged in a flex row. Named regions `start` (after the logo) and `end` (pushed to the far end) take a node or ordered `{ id, node, order, hidden }` items, for controls other modules contribute.

components.name: AppNav
components.description: Horizontal navigation bar. Renders inline links on desktop and a hamburger that opens a NavDrawer on mobile. Provides logo, navItems and actions slots.

components.name: NavDrawer
components.description: Wrapper that wraps any trigger and children inside a drawer. Manages its own open/closed state. Used as AppNav's mobile menu and also works standalone.

components.name: GlobalSearch
components.description: Command-palette-style global search field. Supports a categorised result list, keyboard navigation and result selection.

components.name: AppCommandBar
components.description: Keyboard-first command palette. Opens with ⌘K. Lists the `items` it gets plus every command registered with `registerCommand` / `registerCommands` / `useRegisterCommand`; commands carry `group`, `order` and `hidden`. Sample commands only with `demo`.

components.name: SectionCard
components.description: Titled content card with rounded-xl + border + bg-surface-raised + p-6. Header is separated by an underline; children slot accepts arbitrary content.

components.name: InlineAlert
components.description: Compact inline alert strip used next to form fields or inside cards. success / error / warning / info variants; icon + single-line message.

components.name: StepShell
components.description: Wrapper card for a single step in a multi-step flow. Border and number circle change based on active / done / inactive state; the done + onEdit combination shows an Edit button alongside the summary.

components.name: Form
components.description: Form layout wrapper with title, description, error and actions slots. `columns` prop renders fields in a 1 or 2 column grid.

components.name: FilterBar
components.description: Select, multiselect, daterange and text-based filter panel. Supports URL-based filtering via GET form submit.

components.name: FileUploadSection
components.description: High-level upload organism: drop zone + file list + remove. M1 implements drag/drop, paste-from-clipboard, accept-pattern + maxSize + maxFiles validation. M2 will add image thumbnails + crop dialog; M3 chunked + resumable uploads. Pixel-identical EJS sibling at modules/app/FileUploadSection/FileUploadSection.ejs.

components.name: OnboardingWizard
components.description: Multi-step onboarding flow with dots/bar progress, optional skip, and page or modal presentation. Each step renders its own content slot.

a11y.notes: Progress is announced via role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow updating on step change.

components.name: DetailHeader
components.description: Page header for detail/record views: title, subtitle, status badge, action buttons, and optional tab navigation.

components.name: ErrorState
components.description: Error state pairing an inline alert banner with a centered empty state. Optional retry action.

components.name: Gantt
components.description: MS Project / GanttPRO / dhtmlxGantt-style project timeline. M1 ships the scale switcher (day / week / month / quarter / year), a vertical Today line, WBS tree with expand/collapse on the left panel, sticky timeline header with synchronised horizontal + vertical scroll, and absolutely-positioned task bars with a %-progress fill. M2 adds full interactivity: drag a bar to reschedule (snap to day), drag the left/right edges to resize, drag the white progress thumb to change %, and drag from the right-edge blue dot to another bar to draw an FS dependency. Dependencies render as orthogonal SVG arrows with a marker-end arrowhead; click an arrow then press Delete to remove it. M3 adds a Critical Path toggle in the toolbar — tasks on the longest dependency chain switch to var(--error) styling and their connecting arrows turn red, computed by a forward + backward longest-path pass on the dependency DAG. Hovering a bar after a short delay shows a tooltip with name, start/end, duration, owner, % complete, predecessors, and a Critical badge. M4 adds zero-duration milestones rendered as 14×14 diamonds, planned-vs-actual baseline ghost bars beneath the live bars, and weekend + holiday shading on the day + week scales. M5 adds a toolbar Export menu (PNG via SVG `<foreignObject>` round-trip, PDF via the browser print dialog, CSV via a pure-JS Blob download), drag snap that nudges drops forward to the next working day, and a resource-conflict detector that flags over-allocated owners in the WBS panel with a red triangle. M6 closes the loop with grid keyboard navigation (↑↓/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown between rows, +/− zoom, focused bar exposes a focus ring + `aria-activedescendant`), a `locale` prop that drives Intl-based month names and tooltip dates, `prefers-reduced-motion` honouring (plus a `reducedMotion` prop force-on), and automatic row virtualization above ~60 tasks. All mutations are optimistic and roll back automatically if `onTaskUpdate` / `onDependencyCreate` rejects. Internal state is owned by a per-instance Zustand store (`store.ts`).

components.name: EntityAliases
components.description: Dashboard entity aliases and key filters, the ThingsBoard model (next-boilerplate dashboard phases 36.4 and 36.7). EntityAliasesDialog lists a board's aliases (numbered rows, the filter as one readable line, resolve-multiple switch, edit, remove; an alias a widget uses cannot be removed, the widgets are named). EntityAliasDialog adds or edits one alias: name with the key derived on add, resolve-multiple with its hint, the filter form and a debounced preview; a filter that matches no entity blocks the save. EntityFilterForm covers single entity, entity list, name prefix, entity type, the page's entity (a board param), entity subtype, relations query and entity search query (the last two only when the host has a relation provider). AliasEntitySelect is the toolbar's entity select, EntityAliasPicker binds a widget's entity slot (and, once an alias is chosen, one of the board's filters). Key filters (phase 36.7, ThingsBoard's dashboard filters): BoardFiltersDialog lists the board's filters (a filter a widget uses cannot be removed), BoardFilterDialog edits one, KeyFilterEditor edits one key filter (entity field, attribute or latest telemetry; key names suggested through access.entityKeys; up to 4 conditions with the operations of the value type; a value can read a dashboard parameter), boardFilterText writes it as one line. EntityParamFields (phase 41, parameters as one concept) edits an entity parameter: its entity type, how the entity is chosen (the viewer picks, the page or a link sets it, fixed one or list, all of the type, by name, by subtype, related to another parameter or entity), one or many, the filter-bar mode, a default searched by name and "with no value, take the first" (a viewer's pick may be narrowed to some subtypes, a name prefix or a list); the relation details sit under the host's Advanced. EntityParamPicker is the filter bar's entity picker: a search box (type a name; one entity, or many as chips; read-only shows them), the control AliasEntitySelect is built of. The host supplies every read through EntityAliasesAccess; validateAlias and validateBoardFilter mirror the server caps. React only.

components.name: AlarmTable

components.name: AlarmListView
components.description: The alarm list through the IoT adapter: count chips, status / severity filters and search, server paging, selection with bulk acknowledge / clear sharing one note, live arrivals ("N new alarms") and a 30 s re-read without a live source.

components.name: AlarmDetailView
components.description: One alarm through the adapter: header with optimistic acknowledge / clear (rolled back with a toast on refusal), the timeline with a note box, a runbook drawer and a Related panel (device, what raised it, the topic).

components.name: AlarmBellMenu
components.description: The IoT bell: the count of OPEN alarms (its dot in the colour of the worst severity), the latest open alarms with inline acknowledge, Acknowledge all (behind a confirmation with an optional note), and View all. Counts and list follow the live alarm events without asking the host again (alarm-bell-state.ts); the host is asked at the start, after a reconnect, when the list runs short and every 5 minutes. In a host that already has a bell, useAlarmBellSource puts the alarms into its NotificationMenu's one list (sources): their severity look, device and site, inline Acknowledge, a click that opens the alarm, and every OPEN alarm in the badge. AlarmBellSection (a section above that list) still works.

components.name: DeviceOnlineDot

components.name: DeviceDetailHeader

components.name: DeviceCredentialPanel

components.name: DeviceAttributeTable

components.name: DesiredReportedBadge
components.description: The sync state of a shared attribute: in sync, pending, rejected (with the device reason), drifted, unknown key.

components.name: DeviceConnectionTimeline

components.name: DeviceLogTimeline

components.name: DeviceQuickView

components.name: DeviceTable

components.name: DeviceListView

components.name: DeviceDetailView

components.name: NewDeviceDrawer

components.name: RpcStatusBadge

components.name: RpcRequestList

components.name: RpcRequestDetail

components.name: RpcConsoleView

components.name: DeviceProfileListView

components.name: DeviceProfileEditorView

components.name: NewDeviceProfileDrawer

components.name: OnlineRuleField
components.description: The online rule of a profile (OD-57): live connection, recent message (interval × factor with a live "offline after" hint) or last seen only. components.name: AuthModeSelector
components.description: The authentication modes a profile allows: access token, MQTT basic (always a username and a password, OD-163: no client-ID-only mode) and X.509; at least one; locked for an X.509-only template.

components.name: TransportPolicyCard

components.name: TraceWaterfall
components.description: A distributed trace as nested rows with offset and duration bars on a time ruler. Collapse and expand, critical-path highlight, error spans (icon and text, not only colour), a detail slot for the selected span, and a windowed list above 500 rows. Tree semantics (role tree and treeitem, aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected) with aria-activedescendant, so the keyboard works the same when rows are windowed.

keyboardInteractions.action: Expand, collapse, or move to the first child or the parent (mirrored in right-to-left pages)
Select the span and open its details

components.name: LogViewer
components.description: A windowed log list for 10k+ lines: severity as a text label and colour, search with highlight, severity and field facet chips, a wrap toggle, copy line, context lines pulled in around a selected line when the list is filtered, and a follow mode for a live tail (pauses when the user scrolls up, counts new lines, shows a drop counter). `useLogStream` is the producer side: it coalesces pushes, keeps the newest lines and counts drops.

keyboardInteractions.keys: ArrowUp / ArrowDown / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End
keyboardInteractions.action: Move the selection through the lines

components.name: ServiceMap
components.description: Services and the calls between them on a deterministic layered layout (no graph library): rate, error and latency badges, pan and zoom, roving-focus keyboard navigation along the call graph, and a selection slot. Errors are never colour alone: a warning icon and percentage, a heavier border and a dashed edge.

keyboardInteractions.action: Follow a call downstream or upstream (mirrored in right-to-left pages)

components.name: CitationChip
components.description: A numbered evidence chip [1] that links to its evidence row (a same-page anchor, so it works without JavaScript). A citation that points at nothing renders as a dashed "dropped" chip with a warning icon and text, never as a dead link. `CitedText` turns [n] markers in an answer into chips.

a11y.notes: Each chip is named "Evidence n: title". A dropped chip is text with a name that says the claim was dropped.

components.name: EvidenceList
components.description: The rows an AI answer cites: a number, a kind icon and label, a title that opens the row, a summary, source and time. Claims dropped for citing nothing openable are listed apart with a text indicator. Pair with CitationChip: a chip click highlights its row.

a11y.notes: An ordered list. The dropped-claims block is a status region.

components.name: DayBarChart
components.description: One bar per day, the 90-day uptime strip of a status page. Coloured by availability, with height, an incident marker and the day's accessible name carrying the same meaning, a tooltip on hover and focus, a pinned details dialog on click, and a legend. Reusable per component and per region: pass a label.

keyboardInteractions.action: Previous or next day (mirrored in right-to-left pages)

components.name: AiHumanDraftEditor
components.description: The AI's draft beside the human's text, diffed by words, with accept and reject per change and accept all. The text stays the human's until they accept; the value is controlled. A badge says the draft is AI-generated. Changes are marked by shape (strike and underline) and a number shown in both panels, and every button names its change.

a11y.notes: Each change is a group named "Change n of m"; accept and reject buttons say what they replace. Results are announced in a polite status region.

components.name: ConversationTimeline
components.description: A vertical timeline of an AI investigation: model calls, tool calls, the evidence read, and whether each citation was kept or dropped, with tokens, cost and time per step and a total. Every step names its type in text; arguments and raw results collapse.

a11y.notes: An ordered list; details toggles are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls.

components.name: InlineEditList
components.description: A list whose rows edit in place: add, edit, remove and reorder, all from the keyboard, with a validation message per row and an async save state per row. Controlled: every change goes through onChange(next, change); return a promise to show saving, reject to show the row's error.

components.name: LocaleSwitcher
components.description: A language picker for public pages. Options are links when they have an href (a native details menu, so it works without JavaScript) or buttons when they do not. Names are shown in their own language with lang and dir set, the current locale is marked in text, and a locale whose page falls back to another language says so. Not the flag dropdown LanguageSwitcher of the common domain: no flag assets and no i18n dependency.

keyboardInteractions.action: Close and return to the trigger

components.name: BurnChart
components.description: An SLO burn view on the Chart primitives: the error budget remaining with a projection that runs to zero at the recent pace, the burn rate with the alerting tiers as labelled thresholds (the SRE workbook's 14.4 / 6 / 3 / 1 by default), and annotations such as a deploy or an incident. Colour is not the only signal: tiers and annotations carry text, the projection is dashed, and a text summary states the budget, the active tier and the projected exhaustion.

keyboardInteractions.action: Step the cursor through the points; the tooltip follows

components.name: KUIViewer
components.description: Browser-based IFC/BIM 3D viewer built on Three.js, web-ifc and @thatopen/fragments. Ships a vanilla TypeScript core plus an optional React subpath (`kui-viewer/react`) exposing the `<KUIViewer />` component, a `ViewerProvider`, and a Zustand-backed `useViewerStore` hook for selection, federation and spatial-tree state. In-viewport widgets — an interactive NavCube, a pill toolbar (`viewer.toolbar`) and a dolly ZoomSlider — mount as children of `<KUIViewer />` and wire themselves to the live camera via `useViewer`.
components.whenToUse: When you need to render IFC/BIM models in the browser — viewing, navigating and inspecting AEC scenes — and want a framework-agnostic core with an optional React wrapper.
components.whenNotToUse: For lightweight, non-BIM 3D scenes — prefer a thinner Three.js wrapper or react-three-fiber. KUIViewer pulls in web-ifc WASM and @thatopen/fragments and is sized for AEC workloads.
